verdict.rationale: Lighthouse says its case platform handles document collection: "from uploading documents to tracking what is ready" (lighthouse-supp-platform). That points to structured uploads and readiness tracking instead of email attachments, and a dedicated case manager and progress reports support the workflow. This rests on one marketing line, with no detail on how the workflow actually operates. Missing for 10: documented checklists or per-case evidence requirement lists, automated reminders or nudges, detail on the upload and tracking workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
